model: NT Series duct / outside air RH and temperature sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
aliases: Greystone NT outside air RH sensor
applies_to: Greystone NTDABAC duct and NTOABAC outside air RH/temperature network sensors with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: Duct and outside air RH/temperature sensors with native BACnet MS/TP. Temperature and humidity are two Analog Inputs, each with an offset Analog Value, and one Binary Value switches °C/°F. The MAC address is set with DIP switches.
notes: The NTDABAC (duct) and NTOABAC (outside air) guides print the same five objects.
Temperature offset resolution is 0.5 °C or 1 °F; RH offset resolution is 1 %RH.
Default device object name is RHT 001.

source.title: Duct RH/Temp Sensor NTDABAC Installation Instructions

integration.summary: Set the MAC with the DIP switches, then read AI 1 and AI 2. Choose units with BV 1 before writing offsets.
setup: MAC address is set with 7 DIP switches (0-127).
Device instance defaults to 381000 + MAC (381001); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
